1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi. Ni iya Dawidi.

2.text: Uwiteka, uzageza he kunyibagirwa iteka ryose?Uzageza he kunyima amaso?

3.text: Nzageza he kwigira inama,Mfite agahinda mu mutima wanjye uko bukeye?Umwanzi wanjye azageza he gushyirwa hejuru yanjye?

4.text: Uwiteka Mana yanjye, birebe unsubize,Hwejesha amaso yanjye,Kugira ngo ne gusinzira ibitotsi by'urupfu.

5.text: Umwanzi wanjye ye kuvuga ati “Ndamunesheje”,Abanteraga be kwishimira kunyeganyega kwanjye.

6.text: Ariko niringiye imbabazi zawe,Umutima wanjye uzishimira agakiza kawe.Ndaririmbira Uwiteka,Kuko yangiriye neza.
